# Pour Score

> Pour Score is a latte art coach app for home baristas. It guides each pour step by step, shows the angle of your jug live, and takes you from your first heart to a swan. It is in early access and launching on the App Store and Google Play.

## What it does

- Guided pours: a path draws itself across the cup in time with the pour, at full, half or quarter speed.
- Live tilt reading: the phone shows the angle of the jug or cup in degrees and turns green when you are in range for that phase.
- Dry rehearsal: practise the hand movement with an empty jug, so no milk is wasted.
- Perfect your milk: short lessons on stretching, texture and swirling milk, with fixes for beige milk, big bubbles and thin foam.
- Nine latte art patterns, in the order the app teaches them: monk's head, heart, tulip, rippled heart, rosetta, stacked tulip, swan, etched animals and stacked rosetta.
- Pour log with a photo, a streak and five tiers: Beginner, Home Pourer, Confident, Café Ready and Barista. Tiers are earned from real pours.
- Coaching that fits your kit: set up your coffee station once and the guide fits your jug and cup.

## Who it is for

Adults (18+) with an espresso machine and a jug of milk, from new machine owners pouring a first heart to home baristas working on rosettas and swans.

## Pages

- [Home](https://pourscoreapp.com/): what Pour Score is and how it works
- [Latte art patterns](https://pourscoreapp.com/latte-art-patterns/): the nine patterns in learning order, each with its tier
- [Learn latte art at home](https://pourscoreapp.com/learn-latte-art/): a guide for the home barista: kit, typical milk per drink, where to start, practice and common questions. States plainly that Pour Score is not a course, qualification or live class
- [Support](https://pourscoreapp.com/support/): how to contact Pour Score, report a security problem and delete your account
- [Features](https://pourscoreapp.com/features/): guided pours, live tilt, dry rehearsal, milk lessons, progress and streaks
- [Privacy Policy](https://pourscoreapp.com/privacy/)
- [Terms of Service](https://pourscoreapp.com/terms/)
